Об игре"FMTC" is a multiplayer online shooting game (TPS+FPS) with 2Tap gameplay. Choose the right landing spot, select skills that suit you, and search for weapons, ammunition, armor, vehicles, and other equipment. One shot to break the helmet, the second shot to kill with a headshot, two shots to eliminate enemies. Every moment is a matter of life and death.
description_short: FMTC is a multiplayer online shooter (TPS+FPS), 2Tap gameplay category. Choose the right location to land, choose the right skills for you, search for weapons, ammo, armor, vehicles and other equipment. One shot helmet, one shot head, two shots can kill the enemy, every moment, it is life and death.
